request.query: multivariate integer polynomial sum absolute coefficients norm submultiplicative product

items.name: Finset.nnnorm_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖₊

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n (p * q) = ∑ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, MvPolynomial.coeff x.1 p * MvPolynomial.coeff x.2 q

items.name: norm_prod
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedCommRing α] [NormMulClass α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset β)
  (f : β → α), ‖∏ b ∈ s, f b‖ = ∏ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖

items.name: NormedDivisionRing.toNormMulClass
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : NormedDivisionRing α], NormMulClass α

items.name: Finset.nnnorm_prod_le'
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] (s : Finset ι),
  s.Nonempty → ∀ (f : ι → α), ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖₊

items.name: MvPolynomial.mul_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p q : MvPolynomial σ R},
  p * q = Finsupp.sum p fun m a => Finsupp.sum q fun n b => (MvPolynomial.monomial (m + n)) (a * b)

items.name: Multipliable.norm_tprod
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedCommRing E] [NormMulClass E] [NormOneClass E] {f : α → E},
  Multipliable f → ‖∏' (i : α), f i‖ = ∏' (i : α), ‖f i‖
